name: FolioIcon
source_reference: apps/web/public/icons/logo.png (project-local original Folio logo: charcoal two-page open book with violet bookmark, transparent canvas 678x716)
brief: App icon converted from the ORIGINAL Folio logo (user clarified: the logo is the original charcoal+bookmark logo.png, not the green-book mark). Fully transparent canvas per user request — no plate, no background. Original colors preserved: charcoal #23242F book, violet #715CFC flat bookmark.

semantic_review.basis: owned project-local source raster (logo.png); per-component color segmentation + potrace curve fitting; silhouette, gap rhythm, page curves and bookmark geometry read as the same mark at glance; awaiting human acceptance
semantic_review.notes: Traced from the owned raster per component (component-level vectorization was allowed since layer semantics separate cleanly by color). Flat colors sampled from pixels. No plate/background layers; no material helpers.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: original Folio logo: charcoal two-page open book with center transparent gap, violet flat bookmark overlapping the right page; transparent background
must_preserve: two-page silhouette with center gap, rounded outer corners, wing-like page curves
violet flat bookmark overlapping the right page top-right, notch pointing down
must_not_add: green plate or any filled background
material effects, glow, shadow, bevel, text, frames
page rules/spine lines (the original logo has none)

spec_constraints: compound path, two disconnected page subpaths as in source

acceptance_checks: overlay glance vs logo.png silhouette: same mark, same gap, same bookmark placement
reads on dark and light backdrops (transparent logo variant caveat recorded)

claims: spec-driven reusable cross-platform icon source package
unrounded app/source canvas outputs retained separately from preview masking
